title: What Is a Hidden State? The Residual Stream, Read and Written
summary: When you copy a hidden state out of a language model, what have you copied? We build the answer from vector addition: a running sum that every part of the model writes into and reads from. Then we turn it into a probe, a push and a rotation with toy numbers, hold Olah's three claims as bets, and read the picture through linear algebra and information theory. Two notebooks check the sum on GPT-2 small and say what was not run.
